message.content: The current Vice President of the United States is **Kamala Harris**. She has been serving in that role since January 20, 2021, following the inauguration of President Joe Biden. Harris is the 49th person to hold the office and the first woman, first Black person, and first person of South Asian descent to serve as Vice President.
